info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: The Loan Replacement API provides the functionality to replace existing loan product details specified by a unique parameter. This endpoint allows users to update attributes of a loan product effectively, addressing various business requirements for financial institutions. Typical consumers of this API include loan management systems and financial service providers looking to maintain up-to-date product offerings. Ensuring aligned loan specifications with market demands can enhance customer satisfaction and improve operational efficiency.

put.summary: Update a loan product by its ID.
put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific loan product identified by its unique ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary data in the request body, and the changes will be applied accordingly.

requestBody.description: Update the details of the specified loan product (LOAN-500045). This request body must contain all necessary information to successfully update the loan product, including any required fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful and the loan product was updated.
